text:
mara_cs: kicking off Harbinger dedicated pool bring-up today. objectives: quota validation, autoscale tuning, load/chaos runs, and enablement handoff. i'll coordinate customer comms.

jason_runtime: thanks — uploaded quota & traffic profile: https://drive.redwood/harbinger/quota-alpha-v2 (see notes on reserved tokens).

linda_sre: what are the SLOs we want to validate? tail latency, error budget, spend cap?

mara_cs: SLOs: 99th latency < 350ms, error rate < 0.5% sustained, soft spend cap $3k/hr. steady target 110 qps, sustained peak 420 qps (10m), short bursts 900 qps (<2m). need KV prewarm before ramp.

jason_runtime: runtime plan: two model variants in pool — production (fp16) and fallback (int8-lite). routing: prefer prod, fallback when node health or util triggers. will flag model switch events in telemetry.

omar_oncall: proposing canary progression: 5% for 3m -> 20% for 12m -> 50% for 30m -> full at 1h if green. will insert health checks and trace snapshots at each step.

linda_sre: autoscale policy suggestion:
- scale up if avg GPU util > 60% for 60s
- scale step +2 nodes, min 4, max 14
- scale down when util < 35% for 4m
- cooldown window 3m between scale events
Also enable circuit-breaker: open when 5% error rate for > 45s.

mara_cs: add to customer checklist for enablement call:
- confirm quota in console + contact billing if mismatch
- run prefix warmup 30m pre-canary
- enable failover route to hosted smallmodel and test it
- ops/alerts configured (latency/cost/error)

jason_runtime: warmup command (run from infra bastion):
```
./prefix_warmup.sh --url http://dedicated.harbinger.internal --tokens 120000 --concurrency 12 --user-profile common_prompts.json
```
This primes KV cache and common prefixes. start 30m before 5% canary.

deploy-bot: deploy-started: dedicated/harbinger-pool v1.4 -> desired_nodes:4

omar_oncall: plan to inject a targeted chaos test at mid-ramp: simulate OOM on one node and validate fallback to hosted variant within 30s, plus ensure no user requests dropped.

linda_sre: also add a hot-shard detector: if tail latency spikes >200ms and remains for 60s, trigger pre-burst rebalance job.

mara_cs: customer contact: @harbinger-eng lead available on +1 line during run. i'll send a short runbook and expected behavior doc. template for post-run feedback:
- latency experience vs expectation
- any truncation or bad completions
- perceived cost increase vs baseline
- suggestions for warmup timing or routing rules

jason_runtime: load test sequence (condensed):
1) prefix warmup 30m
2) smoke canary 5% x 3m
3) ramp to 20% over 10m with checks
4) ramp to 50% over 30m stationary probes
5) chaos injection (single-node), validate fallback
6) burst tests: 900 qps x 90s x 3 windows
7) cooldown and collect traces + metrics

omar_oncall: i'll own oncall coverage and immediate escalations. linda will monitor infra and autoscale. jason take runtime telemetry and traces. mara owns customer comms.

mara_cs: one more: set automated abort conditions — if spend > $3.2k/hr OR 95th latency > 600ms for >90s, autopause ramp and notify #billing + #eng-oncall.

jason_runtime: implemented guard: abort_on: {"cost":3200,"latency_ms":600} (infra rule). will post alerts when thresholds hit.

deploy-bot: deploy-complete: dedicated/harbinger-pool v1.4 -> active_nodes:6

omar_oncall: canary started. monitors healthy after 2m. proceeding to 20% now. will post short status updates here.

jason_runtime: KV hit-rate at 20m warmup = 85%. 99th = 330ms at 50% load window. traces saved: /traces/harbinger/2472001111-1

linda_sre: observed a transient tail spike during first burst; root cause = hot shard on node-3 due to uneven token routing. auto-rebalance restarted a pod and latencies recovered. no client errors logged.

mara_cs: noted. action item: add pre-burst rebalance job + monitor. jason, can you take that?

jason_runtime: on it — adding shard-aware placement job and will schedule 90s pre-burst rebalance.

omar_oncall: chaos injected at +45m. fallback engaged for 22s, no dropped requests, routing to hosted variant succeeded. ramp resumed.

mara_cs: quick capture for retro:
- warmup: timing acceptable
- autoscale thresholds effective with minor tuning
- fallback and circuit-breaker worked
- pre-burst shard balancing needed (action: jason)
- customer reported small increase in perceived latency during bursts but within acceptable range

jason_runtime: follow-up: add telemetry flag to mark requests served by fallback model for customer billing reconciliation.

mara_cs: closing notes: post-run retro scheduled at 14:00 PT. i'll assemble a summary and send the feedback form to customer. thanks team :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: analytics: peak_qps=910, avg_qps=220, peak_nodes=12, pool_cost_hr=$2950

omar_oncall: all green. posting final logs and closing thread.

mara_cs: great work everyone. will publish the customer report and retention notes later today.
